headline: Digital lenders’ bad loan ratio climbs to nearly 12%–CIBI
summary: Nonperforming loans at digital lenders climbed to an upper level over the past three years, according to credit bureau CIBI. The growth reflects rapid expansion of small, short-term loans.
why: Digital lenders extend small, fast credit to consumers, and their loan quality shapes funding costs and risk for fintech and banking investors. Rising bad loans signal stress in consumer credit.
